summary.headline: Electronics Mart Q1 FY27 revenue rose 39% to INR 2,419 crore and PAT to INR 121 crore, with reported EBITDA margin at 9.9%.
summary.overview: Q1 FY27 was the company's strongest quarter to date, driven by a strong AC season, healthy footfalls and conversions, and 34.2% same-store sales growth. Gross margin expanded to 17.2% from 14.6%, aided by cooling-product mix and temporary price-increase gains in IT hardware. Working capital days fell to 42 from 73 and working capital borrowings dropped to INR 97 crore from INR 658 crore at the start of the quarter. Management guided FY27 revenue growth of 18-20% and a post-Ind AS EBITDA margin of 7.5-8%, and said the margin tailwinds are partly temporary.

segments.name: Large appliances
segments.commentary: 48% of revenue, led by air conditioners, with traction in washing machines and refrigerators. AC season was the best quarter yet by volume and value.

segments.name: Mobile phones
segments.commentary: 39% of revenue in Q1 FY27, down from 40% in the comparable base, as cooling-product mix rose seasonally.

segments.name: South cluster
segments.commentary: Revenue +40% YoY with EBITDA margin of 10.9%. Andhra Pradesh revenue +62% (SSG 49.1%), Telangana up-country +48% (SSG 40%), Hyderabad city +34% (SSG 32.3%).

segments.name: North cluster
segments.commentary: Revenue +29% YoY with record EBITDA margin of 4.9%. Management said North market for cooling products was negative versus 2024.

segments.name: Store maturity
segments.commentary: 96 stores older than 4 years run at 11.2% EBITDA margin; 131 stores under 4 years old delivered 8.1%.

guidance_outlook: FY27 revenue growth guided at 18-20% YoY, described as 'very easily achievable'; upside possible if Q4 season is strong. Management declined to commit to INR 10,000 crore revenue.
FY27 full-year gross margin guided at 15-15.5%, below the Q1 level, as Q1 benefited from temporary price-increase gains.
Post-Ind AS EBITDA margin guided at 7.5-8% for FY27; management called 9% 'too optimistic'.
Finance cost expected to be at least INR 10 crore lower than last year's ~INR 150 crore.
Plan to open 25-30 stores in FY27 across existing geographies and West Bengal; 5 Kolkata stores by Diwali and 10-12 by end-Q4 FY27; 8-10 NCR stores in FY27 and about 5 South stores.
West Bengal capex about INR 100 crore for stores plus about INR 50 crore for property purchases over the next two years, funded from internal accruals.
risks_watch: Gross margin tailwind from temporary price-increase gains in laptops and mobiles may reverse; management guides FY27 gross margin to 15-15.5%.
Delhi NCR same-store sales weak as North cooling-product market declined; management expects improvement but gave no quarterly figures.
Memory-chip shortages may force higher stock levels (50-60 days instead of 30) for some IT and mobile SKUs.
Management could not quantify the share of inventory bought at lower prior-year cost, so the gross margin benefit is hard to isolate.
Quality of the Q1 base: the comparison is against a weak AC season in Q1 FY26, so the growth rate may not persist.
New store ramp in West Bengal and North; execution against 25-30 openings a year and the 10-12 Kolkata target by March 2027.
